data.description:
Cut the CI cost of obtaining the tickets branch by ~15x. Measured: full clone **1.04 GiB / 59 s
wall / 319 s CPU**; `--filter=blob:none` **68.7 MiB / 14.3 s**. session_log **1cb6-d553-6565-49b4** (measured facts; do not re-derive).

## Where the cost actually is (this is the correction that makes the ticket work)
The tickets branch is **not** mounted by `actions/checkout` directly — all three workflows mount it
manually (`reconcile-bridge.yml:115-117`, `verify-identity.yml:55-57`,
`reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:86-88`) with `git fetch origin '+tickets:...'` + `git worktree add`.
Adding a filter **there** is a no-op: the objects are already local. Measured on run 30494781536:

| step | duration |
|---|---|
| `actions/checkout` (`fetch-depth: 0`) | **237 s** |
| manual tickets mount | **2 s** |

`fetch-depth: 0` makes `actions/checkout` fetch **all** branches, so the 1.04 GiB arrives in that
237 s step. So the filter goes on the **`actions/checkout@v7`** steps
(`reconcile-bridge.yml:81-89`, `verify-identity.yml:34-36`, `reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:74-80`).
The later manual fetch then **inherits** `remote.origin.partialclonefilter` — that inheritance is
load-bearing and must be asserted. Prize: 237 s x 72 runs/day at the `*/20` cron = 4.7
runner-hours/day of checkout, of which the measured reduction is ~76%, so **~3.5 runner-hours/day**
as an upper bound.

`actions/checkout` has supported a `filter:` input since **v4.1.0**. Note `filter` **overrides**
`sparse-checkout` in that action.

## Why blob:none is safe here
Whole-store `verify-identity` in a blobless clone fetched **0 bytes** and ran *faster* than in a full
clone (3.75 s vs 3.98 s): its scan is a pure tree-level diff (`--diff-filter=A --name-only
--no-renames`) and event/keyring bodies are read from the **working tree**
(`verify_authorship.py:371`, `authorship.py:119-128`). Never use `--filter=tree:0`: measured at
**3.57 GiB across 2,255 promisor packs — 3.4x LARGER than a full clone**.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A controlled **before/after byte measurement** (pack size, or `GIT_TRACE_PACKET` received
      bytes) of a fresh CI checkout with and without the filter shows the expected reduction. Tier:
      **CI job measurement**. Must NOT be a config-presence assertion: git writes
      `partialclonefilter` **even when the server ignored the filter** (reproduced), so that check
      passes on a full clone.
- [ ] The subsequent manual tickets fetch is confirmed to **inherit**
      `remote.origin.partialclonefilter` (the mechanism the saving depends on). Tier: **CI job
      assertion**.
- [ ] A reconciler pass completes green on a blobless runner, including a reconverge against a
      diverged remote (jointly with B3). Tier: **CI end-to-end**.
- [ ] Whole-store `verify-identity` on a blobless runner triggers **no** promisor fetch (pack count
      and size unchanged across the run). Tier: **CI job measurement**.

## Files
`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge.yml`, `.github/workflows/verify-identity.yml`,
`.github/workflows/reconcile-bridge-canary.yml`

Scope: S. **Depends on B3.**
data.title: B1: add filter: blob:none to the actions/checkout steps that bring in the tickets branch
